Headquarters: Austria (remote); London

Role Purpose: 

The Forward Deployed Identity Strategist serves as a customer-facing Fraud and Identity subject matter expert across the entire customer lifecycle, operating as a forward-deployed consultant across pre-sales, onboarding, and ongoing expansion. In this role, you will partner directly with enterprise customers to design optimal product implementation strategies, evaluate risk profiles, and align Jumio’s technical solutions with customer’s unique business objectives.

The Identity Strategist owns the critical onboarding mission for new deployments. Acting as a strategic advisor, you are directly responsible for driving efficient customer onboarding and rollout, and overcoming regulatory, legal, or operational hurdles to accelerate time-to-live and maximize time-to-value while ensuring solution adoption and long-term trust.

Responsibilities:

• Partner with new and existing Jumio customers to evaluate their risk profile and design tailored fraud strategies

• Provide expert recommendations on risk mitigation, user friction, and verification workflow optimization

• Lead the designing of standardized identity workflows within the Jumio product that are optimized for different verticals and use cases that can be quickly adopted by new customers

• Orchestrate launch readiness by proactively identifying and resolving technical, regulatory, or policy-related bottlenecks to drive time-to-live and time-to-value

• Advise customer risk and fraud teams on emerging fraud vectors and industry best practices

• Validate completion of implementation milestones and success criteria, as well as confirming that the customer’s integration aligns with Jumio best practices

• Coordinate go-live planning, readiness reviews, and support go-live day execution

Skills, Experience and Qualifications:

• Relevant professional experience spanning fraud, identity, AML/KYC, digital risk, or a related field, including meaningful customer-facing experience in consulting, technical account management, solutions, professional services, product, or implementation.

• Strong consultative, analytical, and strategic thinking abilities with a focus on risk strategy and workflow design

• Project Management skills and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, Legal/Compliance to deliver outcomes for Jumio customers

• Ability to distill complex, technical fraud concepts into clear, value-driven narratives for executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with identity verification, fraud, compliance, fintech, or enterprise software solutions

• Technical understanding of APIs, integrations, SaaS platforms, or implementation methodologies

• Project management certification or equivalent experience

• Experience working with global enterprise customers

Jumio Values:

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities: 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

About Jumio:

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Applicant Data Privacy 

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com.

29580898e89445ff.description:
About Nivoda
Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.
We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀
Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️
We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role 
We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.
You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing? 
• 
Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it
• 
Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great
• 
Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand
• 
Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts
• 
Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does
• 
Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment
• 
Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows
• 
Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts
• 
Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top
• 
Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand
• 
Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned
• 
Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it
What do we need from you? 
• 
Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport
• 
A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for
• 
Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative
• 
Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel
• 
Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months
• 
Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board
• 
The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model
• 
Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next
• 
Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team
Nice to have 
• 
Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step
• 
Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture
• 
Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue
• 
International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages
• 
Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup
Our culture and what we offer 🌍
We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Our current benefits
• 
⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture
• 
🏡 Remote work
• 
🏥 Private health insurance
• 
📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning
• 
💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)
• 
🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance
• 
📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase
Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location.

Equal opportunity
Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.
Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not.

Join our Talent Pool
Not quite the right role, or the timing isn't right? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we'll be in touch when something fits: https://nivoda.net/talent-pool

29b9c9c78b1b6cca.description:
About the Role at RobCo
RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. 
 
As our Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Workflows (m/f/d), you'll build the agentic workflows that run our solution delivery behind the scenes. Every customer project produces requirements, designs, plans, and checks on the way from a customer's problem to a robot running on their factory floor. Your agents will work at each of these steps: reviewing requirements before they become commitments, checking and improving artifacts as the project moves, and catching risks while there's still time to act on them. You'll build the first agentic workflows, the reusable components and governance they run on, and much of how RobCo uses AI internally.
Your Responsibilities
• 
Design, build, and run agentic workflows across our delivery process - requirements review, automated checks and gates, early risk detection, and a knowledge base that makes everything we've learned from past projects available to agents and people - owning each from concept through production.
• 
Build the way we build: reusable components, skills, and patterns for tool integrations, feedback loops, and identity, secret, and auth management. You know the agentic toolbox inside out and decide what we actually need and what we don't.
• 
Own quality end to end: design and run evals, monitor agents in production, and manage observability, cost, guardrails, and security so teams can trust what the agents produce.
• 
Design human-in-the-loop workflows that learn: people review and correct agent output at defined checkpoints, and those corrections flow back into better prompts, evals, and components, so the agents keep improving.
• 
Embed with our delivery teams to understand how their work actually flows, identify where agents create the most leverage, and define together what good looks like.
• 
Drive adoption and help shape how RobCo uses AI internally: deliver agents through the tools teams already use every day, establish best practices, and build paved paths so teams can eventually create their own agents.
We're looking for someone who has:
• 
Several years of software engineering experience and the seniority to take a problem from ambiguous idea to production system, with clean architecture, solid testing, and maintainable code.
• 
Shipped LLM-powered or agentic systems that real users depend on, not just prototypes: tool calling, structured outputs, multi-step workflows. Deep, practical experience with the agentic stack — orchestration, tool use, MCP, memory, and retrieval — in production environments.
• 
Strong context engineering and prompt engineering skills: you think carefully about what the model sees and in what structure, you treat prompts as versioned, tested engineering artifacts, and you have a rigorous way of judging whether the output is actually good.
• 
Built knowledge bases and put RAG pipelines to work. You don't need to be a retrieval specialist; you need to make organizational knowledge reliably available to agents and people.
• 
Thinks in terms of systems and user outcomes, not individual scripts and demos, and brings a component mindset: while building the first agent, you're already thinking about the second and the tenth.
• 
Genuine enjoyment of working with non-engineering teams: understanding their process, speaking their language, and designing automation around how they actually work.
• 
Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, plus fluency with SaaS APIs, webhooks, and the practical realities of integrating business systems.
• 
Ownership of outcomes and a startup way of working: scope intentionally, build smart, ship fast, and prefer pragmatic solutions that ship over perfect ones that don't.
• 
Fluent English (German is a plus).
Why join RobCo?
• 
Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.
• 
Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.
• 
As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.
• 
Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.
• 
Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.
• 
Flexible working hours, a modern office in Munich whenever you with to visit, and the flexibility to work from home.
• 
Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.
About RobCo
Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.
We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.
Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
This role focuses on advancing the science and systems behind ML measurement, feature understanding, and causal inference at scale. The work spans areas such as production feature importance platforms, observational causal estimation in Pytorch, large-scale proxy metric development, and data-driven approaches to ML infrastructure efficiency. We're looking for an enthusiastic individual contributor to perform high-impact technical work across this space. This person will drive foundational innovations, own the end-to-end design of production ML systems, establish rigorous methodological standards, and partner cross-functionally to turn successful research into durable platform capabilities that raise the ceiling for the entire ML organization.

What you’ll do:

We are looking for an experienced and highly capable Data & Applied Scientist to help us drive step function improvements in our ML capabilities at Pinterest. 

In this role, you will:

• Translate research-grade DS workflows (e.g., proxy metrics, staleness models) into production ML pipelines using Airflow, WandB & Ray while establishing reusable patterns for other teams.

• Apply and productionize causal inference methods using the production ML stack (propensity scoring, IPW, TMLE) to address high-stakes measurement questions beyond experimental capabilities. Build self-serve tooling to empower non-experts to derive rigorous causal insights at scale.

• Partner with ML engineers and product teams to identify opportunities for improved tooling, metrics, and measurement methods, unlocking step-change improvements in model quality and business outcomes.

• Leverage Pinterest's rich metadata and engagement signals to build data-driven frameworks, from feature importance to content deindexing, that improve platform efficiency and speed.

• Design and build centralized ML platform tooling to improve feature and model creation, evaluation, and trust, including production systems that operate daily at scale across all models.

What we’re looking for:

• 2+ years of hands-on experience as an applied scientist, ML engineer, research scientist or software engineer, with significant ML production experience.

• Strong Python skills; experience with PyTorch or equivalent deep learning frameworks; familiarity with distributed compute (Spark, Ray). Ray specifically is a strong plus.

• Enthusiasm for building tools and platforms that multiply the impact of an entire ML organization; not just solving one-off problems.

• Deep ML theory knowledge with extremely strong fundamentals that can help us reason about ML models from first principles.

• Proficiency in software development best practices including version control, code review, and reproducible ML pipelines.

• Experience with workflow management tools (Airflow, Prefect, Jenkins, or similar) for reliable ML pipeline orchestration.

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 3-5 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

29e46eb1dbe5c485.description: ## About Us We are an AI-driven analytics platform startup focused on building automated decision-making solutions. Our current focus is **Athena**, our decision intelligence product for the equipment finance industry — helping lenders turn underwriting, risk, and portfolio data into real-time, automated decisions. --- ## Role Overview This is the core quantitative role behind Athena's decision intelligence products — not a generalist business analyst or PM role. You'll own translating complex financial and risk logic into specifications our data engineering team can build against, and validate that the resulting pipelines produce numbers that are actually correct. The bar here is quantitative reasoning and data fluency, not years of BA/PM titles. There will be a structured transition period supported by our outgoing product lead. --- ## What You'll Own - Translate complex business and financial logic — equipment lease valuation (net investment method, true present value at contractual rate, fair value at current market rate), risk-based pricing, portfolio risk concentration, vintage curve analysis, macro-to-industry credit risk sensitivity — into specs engineers can build against - Design and evolve data pipelines iteratively: identify and specify the derived/ancillary tables needed as logic gets built out (e.g., a present-value table that has to exist before a concentration calculation can run on top of it) - Validate model outputs directly against the database — pull raw and transformed data, sanity-check that logic was applied correctly, and catch anomalies before they reach production (e.g., an implausible vintage projection) - Own the implementation judgment calls — null handling, edge cases, and the steady stream of clarifying questions that surface as engineers build out the logic - Build and maintain real working knowledge of the schema — data type quirks, which values are stored raw vs. derived — so business logic maps cleanly onto what's actually in the tables - Work directly with the founder to turn high-level business requirements into precise, unambiguous logic --- ## Must-Have - Strong quantitative background — applied math, statistics, economics, engineering, actuarial science, or similar - Strong SQL — comfortable writing and debugging complex queries directly against Postgres to validate outputs, not just reading dashboards built by others - Real comfort with quantitative financial reasoning — time value of money, risk and probability concepts (equipment/lease finance exposure is a strong plus, not required) - Ability to break an ambiguous business problem into a precise, step-by-step logical flow - High agency — comfortable being the primary translation layer between founder and engineering with minimal oversight --- ## Nice-to-Have - Background in credit risk, actuarial work, or quantitative/statistical modeling within lending, NBFC, or fintech - Exposure to data pipeline concepts (ETL, orchestration tools like Dagster, layered bronze-to-gold architecture) - FRM/CFA (partial or full) or equivalent quantitative finance coursework — not required, but signals the right reasoning muscle --- ## What We Offer - Full-time role with a structured transition period, supported directly by the outgoing product lead - Direct ownership of the hardest, most central problem in the product — not ticket execution - Direct access to the founder and outsized influence over how the product's core logic is built - A small, sharp team solving a genuinely hard problem in equipment finance ## Compensation ₹10–12 LPA, fixed cash, based on experience and demonstrated quantitative/data fluency. No equity component for this role.

About Druva

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

About the Team

The SaaS Apps product line is a significant revenue generator for Druva with massive expansion and growth plans in the near term. With the explosion in AI and the implications for data protection, data governance, identity and security, many key Druva initiatives are being driven out of the SaaS Apps team.  This is a key role with major scope and will provide opportunity for immediate impact and company-wide visibility.  The candidate will gain valuable experience in a hyper-growth startup and develop key career skills on driving a growing product to product-market fit and SaaS go-to-market. 

Role Purpose & Impact 

This is a field and customer-facing product management role which  acts as a strategic partner to senior leadership, influencing  product direction and aligning the SaaS roadmap with company objectives.  You will collaborate with our cross-functional customer-facing teams to interact with our growing customer base to understand their data protection, security and governance needs and bring back insights and  ideas for Druva’s roadmap.  

What You’ll Do

  • Explore new product features, concepts and develop comprehensive market/product requirements across SaaS applications
  • Sales, Customer interaction for product demos, roadmap presentations, product feedback and escalations
  • Analyze business metrics to develop insights for product go-to-market activities and execute on them in collaboration with product marketing, sales
  • Work with product managers and product marketing team to build key product marketing collateral and deliver field sales team training
  • Analyze product telemetry to develop insights for product roadmap and drive product adoption
  • Respond to industry analyst questionnaires, surveys and develop analyst facing presentations

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 8+ years of total professional experience building and shipping B2B SaaS products, with at least 5 years of functional product management experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, MBA would be a plus
  • Experience working in the data protection domain, particularly in the Microsoft ecosystem (M365, Copilot, D365, Intune)
  • Experience with other major SaaS platforms (Google, Salesforce, ServiceNow) a major plus
  • Experience with Identity infrastructure (Entra ID, Okta, Active Directory) a major plus

Highly technical background with an ability to dive deep into products, technology, UX

  • Excellent product sense with an ability/empathy to deeply focus on customer pain points, workflows and an ability to articulate the same
  • Highly analytical with an ability to understand metrics, develop a data driven point-of-view

Excellent PM presence with clear written, verbal communication skills

  • Track record of iterating, taking ownership and driving products from concept to execution
  • Experience working in high growth, startup environments, with a can-do attitude

What Success Looks Like in the Role

  • Ensure customer success through strategic leadership, operational excellence, and collaboration with cross-functional teams
  • Establish strong relationships with customers and partners in order to drive outside-in thinking across the organization
  • Identify new business opportunities based on deep understanding of customer needs, competitive offerings, and Druva’s unique value proposition
  • Drive planning and execution of new high-profile products to support revenue growth.
  • Enable the sales and technical sales teams so that they can successfully sell products and deliver maximum ROI for customers
  • Mentor and guide junior product managers, fostering a culture of best-practice sharing.
  • Lead the discovery and definition of long-term product strategy, translating market trends and deep customer insights into actionable, multi-quarter roadmaps.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Innovation is how we operate, not a side project. You’ll work in a culture that values bold thinking and continuous improvement, where global teams experiment, iterate, and turn new ideas into products customers can rely on.  

If you’re looking for high-ownership work, visible impact, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, accountability, and growth—where you’ll be trusted to lead and empowered to build—you’ll thrive at Druva.
